edits.intended_fault: ares_client.arm('S-NOPL') zeroes the plasticity rates of the SUBJECT population itself instead of a copy. The driver shares one subject population across a launch's entries in config order (make_configs: S/P-RET, S-NOPL/P-CHAN, S/P-OBS, S/P-ERASE, S-LEAK/P-ERASE, S/P-PRES), so every node after S-NOPL runs plasticity-free: S-LEAK can no longer leak (D = 0 -> P-ERASE DETECTION_UNQUALIFIED for every subject) while S/P-RET, run first, kept its channel; no receipt field records the arm population's plasticity state. The arm tests check the RETURNED population only.
